results.description:
The most addictive dice game you have ever played! Yatzy Multiplayer by LITE Games combines straightforward and intuitive gameplay, pleasing design and animation, advanced customization options and endless fun in this wonderful dice game.

Play offline against the computer with three different difficulty levels to relax or online against real players from all over the world to earn your spot in the global leaderboards. Challenge your friends and family for friendly matches and customize the look and rules of the app to make it truly yours. 

Features:
-	Play online and offline
-	Single- and multiplayer mode 
-	Customize rules and design 
-	Global leaderboards
-	High quality design and animation
-	Adjustable difficulty
-	Many exciting achievements

The app is available in high-quality localizations for the following languages: English, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish & Swedish

The game is perfect for everyone who loves to play board and puzzle games. If you enjoy Backgammon or Solitaire, you'll love it. Your points get counted automatically and the rules are easy to learn. Have a seat at our virtual table within our app and enjoy cool design and sound effects - play now for free! 

If you require help, visit: https://www.lite.games/support/
